scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/core && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/server && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/ui && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/demo
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/demo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/core/src packages/server/src packages/ui/src examples/demo/src e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:data --workspace=@kinloom/demo && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/demo && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:leaks
